class Data(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., title='Name')
    child: Data | None = None


class Data2(BaseModel):
    __hash__ = object.__hash__
    reserved: bool = Field(..., title='Reserved')


class Numbers(RootModel[list[int]]):
    root: list[int]


class Root(BaseModel):
    data: Data
    reserved: Data2 | None = None
    numbers: Numbers | None = Field([], validate_default=True)
    values: frozenset[Data2] | None = Field([], title='Values', validate_default=True)
    custom: Custom | None = None


class Data3(BaseModel):
    id: int = Field(..., title='Id')
    child: Data3 | None = None


class Root2(BaseModel):
    data: Data3


class Model(RootModel[Root | Root2]):
